_readme: Use 'vtf' for local dev (stdio via docker compose exec). Use 'vtf-http' for remote/HTTP transport — requires 'docker compose up -d mcp' and a valid agent token.

vtf._transport: stdio — runs MCP server inside the api container. No auth required. Default for Claude Code on the same machine.

vtf-http._transport: streamable HTTP — connects to the mcp service on port 8002. Requires 'docker compose up -d mcp' and an agent token from 'vtf agent register'.
